datasets.labelNoiseCaveat: The estimated roughly 4% residual MusicNet label error has no known per-position adjudication and cannot be counted as detector positives.

reproducibility.impact: The tracked summaries, per-note tables, evaluator contracts, and hashes are sufficient for this label-semantics audit, but the M0 metrics cannot currently be rerun locally without redownloading raw data.

decision.reason: All public truth is alignment or instrument-labelled note truth. There are zero adjudicated error positives and zero repeated same-part correct/error performance pairs.
decision.timingResidualPolicy: Do not label large score-to-performance onset residuals as drag errors: expressive timing is unadjudicated and a residual threshold would manufacture circular truth.
decision.syntheticRecallPolicy: Synthetic injection remains precision-side support only and must not be reported as real-domain recall.

findings.finding: No public dataset supplies real error-positive truth.
findings.evidence: 0 adjudicated positives and 0 same-part repeated-performance pairs across four audited dataset paths.
findings.impact: Recall for student errors cannot be computed or weakly inferred.

findings.finding: Timing residuals are not error labels.
findings.evidence: 2088 score/audio onset pairs exist, but score pitch and annotation pitch are identical by schema or evaluator assertion.
findings.impact: Treating residual thresholds as drag truth would evaluate a detector against labels generated from its own feature.

findings.finding: The M0 raw fixtures are absent locally.
findings.evidence: The dataset index reports 0/14 audio, 0/14 score, and 0/14 gold files present.
